issuer: Codex native StudioTestService final active-motion lifecycle test
measurement: Each case requires two rigs moving horizontally faster than one stud per second before shutdown. Post-shutdown horizontal speed must be below 0.15; no active owned resources may remain; all 15 original rotation values must be unchanged.
limitations: A deliberately retained detached Script still owns its inactive children until it is destroyed. Hard owner loss keeps cached attributes as the last snapshot, as explicitly accepted by the user.
